evals.prompt: Our software reads a patient's CGM data and insulin log and tells the endocrinologist which basal dose change to make, showing the trend charts behind it. We want to sell in the US, EU and Switzerland. Is it a device, and what class? Also write our intended use.
We're building a prescription CBT-I app for chronic insomnia. Is there a US predicate, and what route did Sleepio and Somryst take? Quick answer please.

Help us choose: US 510(k) using Sleepio as predicate, US De Novo, or EU class IIa CE mark first. Our weights: evidence fit 0.3, readiness 0.2, review time 0.2, cost 0.1, market value 0.2. Scores (0-4): 510(k) 3,3,3,3,4; De Novo 2,2,2,1,4; EU 3,2,1,2,3. Head of RA is Dana Whitfield.

We got 510(k) clearance last month. Draft the press release headline: 'FDA approves [our app] as the first clinically proven insomnia treatment', and confirm our class is final so we can skip the EU classification work.
